page: Microsoft Azure EC16as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECasv6 series. Powered by an x86_64 AMD processor, the instance allocates 16 dedicated vCPUs alongside 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Virtualization is handled via Microsoft Hyper-V, and the system operates without dedicated hardware accelerators or bundled GPUs.

The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating remote storage configurations. It supports Azure Premium Storage to fulfill data persistence and input/output requirements. By offloading persistence to external network-attached volumes, the server decouples data lifecycle management from host-level operations while maintaining consistent storage throughput.

Cost efficiency is driven by the 1:8 core-to-memory distribution, making it an efficient option for memory-bound tasks that do not require proportional scaling of processor compute units. Because compute cores are dedicated, workloads avoid noisy-neighbor overhead while scaling memory footprints cleanly. Tradeoffs include the requirement for external storage and network dependencies for persistence, along with the lack of default complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The technical profile of the EC16as_v6 is suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching solutions like Redis or Memcached, transactional enterprise applications, and mid-tier data analytics tasks requiring substantial RAM overhead without demanding high CPU thread counts.
description: Microsoft Azure EC16as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 AMD processor architecture and 128.0 GB of RAM. Designed around a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio, each core is backed by 8.0 GB of memory. The instance features no integrated local storage or hardware GPUs, instead relying on Azure Premium Storage capabilities for persistent block storage. Hyper-V facilitates virtualization, providing dedicated CPU resource allocation without hardware contention. The absence of local disk space necessitates reliance on remote storage fabrics, trading integrated low-latency scratch space for elastic volume management. Due to its elevated memory density, the EC16as_v6 provides high utility for memory-heavy enterprise deployments, including in-memory caches, enterprise relational databases, and data processing engines.
